decisions.description: Let's check the Donor status of the Household that triggered the flow (using the output values from the subflow). - If it's New or Ongoing, we want to assign the "Ongoing" Donor Status to all Person Accounts in the household. - If it's Lapsed or any other status, we want to check if the household members are Ongoing donors, and, if so, then update the household Donor Status to ongoing.
decisions.name: What_s_the_Household_Donor_Status
decisions.label: What's the Household Donor Status?

decisions.description:
If Household Donor Status is Not Yet A Donor:
- And Member contains Ongoing (And does not contain Lapsed), then Members + HH should be Ongoing
- And Member contains New (And does not contain Ongoing, or Lapsed), then Members + HH should be New
- And Member contains Soon to be Lapsed (And does not contain Ongoing, New, or NotYetDonor), then Members + HH should be Soon to be Lapsed
- And Member contains Lapsed (And does not contain Ongoing, New, or NotYetDonor), then Members + HH should be Lapsed - Right here, we won’t be able to distinguish which lapsed status is needed. So we will just set the Household to “Lapsed”, and the household members might have other lapsed statuses such as “Recent Lapsed” or “Lapsed 3+”
- And Member DOES NOT CONTAIN New, Ongoing, Lapsed, then Members + HH should be Not Yet a Donor
decisions.name: What_s_the_Member_Status_WhenHouseholdIsNotYetADonor
decisions.label: What's the Member Status?

decisions.description: Checks to see if the Account that triggered the flow is one of these: 1. Has type=household 2. Is a person account where IsHouseholdMember=True, or 3. Is any other Account
decisions.name: What_type_of_Account
decisions.label: What type of Account?

decisions.description:
If Household Donor Status is Lapsed:
- And Member contains Ongoing OR New, then Members + HH should be Ongoing
- And Member contains Lapsed or Not Yet a Donor (And does not contain Ongoing or New), then HH should be Lapsed, and members should match HH
decisions.name: Whats_the_Member_Status_whenHouseholdIsLapsed
decisions.label: What's the Member Status?

decisions.description:
If Household Donor Status is New - And Member contains Ongoing, then Members + HH should be Ongoing
- And Member contains New (NOT ONGOING, NOT LAPSED), thenMembers + HH should be New
- And Member contains Lapsed (NOT NEW, NOT ONGOING, NOT NotYetDonor), then Members + HH should be Ongoing
- And Member DOES NOT CONTAIN New, Ongoing, Lapsed, then Members + HH should be New
decisions.name: Whats_the_Member_Status_whenHouseholdIsNew
decisions.label: What's the Member Status?

Flow.description: This flow runs daily on Accounts. It launches a subflow that gets their Donor Gift Summary and assigns Donor Status. Then it goes down a specific path for Household, Household Member, or Other to ensure that Donor Status is updated accordingly across households & related household members. Arkus/BL 4-21-26 v22 - fix logic on the decision element for Lapsed Households. Arkus/BL 4-30-26

formulas.description: Formula is true if the List of Donor Statuses of the Household members CONTAINS "Lapsed"

formulas.description: Formula is true if the List of Donor Statuses of the Household members CONTAINS "New"

formulas.description: Formula is true if the List of Donor Statuses of the Household members CONTAINS "Not Yet a Donor"
formulas.name: householdMemberContainsNotYetADonor
formulas.expression: IF( CONTAINS({!List_Donor_Statuses_of_Household_Members_whenHouseholdIsNew},"Not Yet a Donor"), TRUE, FALSE )

formulas.description: Formula is true if the List of Donor Statuses of the Household members CONTAINS "Ongoing"

formulas.description: Formula is true if the List of Donor Statuses of the Household members CONTAINS "Soon to be Lapsed"
formulas.name: householdMemberContainsSoonToBeLapsed
formulas.expression: IF( CONTAINS({!List_Donor_Statuses_of_Household_Members_whenHouseholdIsNew},"Soon to be Lapsed"), TRUE, FALSE )
